tei:div.tei:p: The burnt-offering is one of the holiest offerings. It is slaughtered on the north side and its blood is received in a sacred vessel on the north side; its blood requires two applications which are [like] four. It must be skinned, severed into parts, and totally consumed by the fire.

tei:note.tei:p: The blood was applied against the southwestern and northeastern corners of the Altar and spread along both sides of each corner so that all four sides of the Altar received the blood.
The Kohanim received no part of the meat which was burned, but they shared in the hide.
